title: mereyabdenbekuly-ctrl/clodex-ide
claim: mereyabdenbekuly-ctrl/clodex-ide — Local-first, zero-trust agentic IDE for verifiable autonomous software development.
why_good: A local-first, zero-trust agentic IDE built around verifiable autonomous development — bets teams want agents that PROVE their changes, not just make them.
value: Sell a team/enterprise tier (verification, audit, on-prem) to orgs that can't let autonomous agents run unchecked.
risk: 'Verifiable autonomous dev' is a big promise; Cursor/Claude Code own the IDE surface and can add verification.

zh.claim: mereyabdenbekuly-ctrl/clodex-ide —— 本地优先、零信任的智能体 IDE,面向可验证的自主软件开发。
zh.why_good: 一个本地优先、零信任、围绕可验证自主开发的智能体 IDE——押注团队想要能证明自己改动、而非只是改的 agent。
zh.value: 给不能让自主 agent 无监督乱跑的组织卖团队/企业版(验证、审计、本地部署)。
zh.risk: 可验证自主开发是个大承诺;Cursor/Claude Code 掌握 IDE 入口,也能加验证。
zh.hook: 一个让自主编码「自证其功」的 agent IDE——本地优先、零信任。

hook: An agent IDE that makes autonomous coding prove its work — local-first and zero-trust.
